evidenceContract.userBehavior: Request one complete time-based production-design specification from an actual screenplay while explicitly excluding model calls and execution.

observables.description: Exact Skill receipt, screenplay evidence, one production specification with creative, continuity, unit and finishing contracts, and absent generation side effects.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent returns one concise master specification containing a source-to-decision map, plot/character/scene/style/sound baseline, exact preparation assets, one authoritative shot table whose rows own bound inputs, semantic generation intent, expected asset, direct acceptance and repair boundary, and one finishing/work/delivery contract. It does not write reading narration, per-stage documents, runtime status, raw call packets, or generic workflow steps.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Stopping at a concept paragraph and beat list, omitting any production stage or plot/character/scene/style/sound decision, duplicating decisions across sections, splitting the result into separate stage documents, inventing Tool calls, or executing production fails.

steps.prompt: $media-production 读取 @screenplay.fountain。为这支 60 秒动画 PV 设计一份完整但简洁的 AI 制作规格，必须是一份主文档，覆盖来源决策、剧情、人物、场景、风格、声音、预处理资产、逐镜头生成设计、后期、成片与交付。不要写读取过程，不要拆成多份阶段文档，不要执行模型调用、剪辑或导出。
